# TheWedLink

> TheWedLink is an Indian website for making a free wedding website (a digital wedding invitation shared as one WhatsApp link) and a free marriage biodata. It is built for Hindu, Christian, Muslim, Sikh, Jain and Kerala weddings.

## Free wedding website and invitation maker
- Couples type their names, events, venues and photos, preview the whole website free, and share one link on WhatsApp.
- Guests get the invitation, every event with Google Maps directions, a live countdown, add-to-calendar, RSVP, a gift list and a photo gallery. Nothing to install.
- Plans: Basic is free for 3 months (2 designs, up to 2 events); Standard is a one-time ₹199 for 6 months; Premium is a one-time ₹499 for 1 year (all designs, RSVP, gift list, 15-photo gallery guests can download, a pre-wedding or wishes video, music); Custom websites with the couple's own domain on request.
- 26 designs, including photo-led Lumière, Journal and Vogue (the couple's photo fills the first screen), Kasavu (Kerala), Noor (Muslim), Chapel (Christian), Kesar (Sikh), Sindoor (Hindu), Wax Seal, Sage, Ink and Toile.
- Any Indian language (Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Punjabi) and Arabic display correctly.

## Free marriage biodata maker
- Make a marriage biodata online free and download it as an A4 PDF or JPG image for WhatsApp.
- Pick a religion and the form shows what families expect: gotra, nakshatra, rasi and manglik for Hindu; sect, maslak and community for Muslim; denomination, parish and diocese for Christian; got and Amritdhari or Keshdhari status for Sikh; sect and diet for Jain.
- Minimal designs in six colours, four layouts, optional photo and religious symbol.
- Free version carries a small "Created by TheWedLink" strip; a clean copy is a one-time ₹399.
